The Travelers’ Choice Awards Best of the Best title celebrates the highest level of excellence in travel. It’s awarded to those who receive a high volume of above-and-beyond reviews and opinions from the Tripadvisor community over a 12-month period. Out of our 8 million listings, fewer than 1% achieve this milestone.
Bliss Hoi An is thrilled to be recognized in Vietnam's elite list of top 25 hotels, courtesy of the prestigious "𝗧𝗿𝗮𝘃𝗲𝗹𝗲𝗿𝘀’ 𝗖𝗵𝗼𝗶𝗰𝗲 𝗔𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀 𝗕𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗕𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟰" by TripAdvisor. This esteemed accolade is a testament to our unwavering commitment to providing exceptional guest experiences.
We take immense pride in our resort's consecutive achievements over the past two years. Our heartfelt gratitude goes out to our dedicated team whose hard work and dedication have contributed to this remarkable success. We also extend our sincere appreciation to our beloved guests for their unwavering support and affection.
For further details on the award, please visit:
https://www.tripadvisor.com/TravelersChoice-Hotels-cTop...
